eligible_event_filtering.exclusion_policy: exclude every ineligible pooled event identically from every detector after raw-row support equality is proven
eligible_event_filtering.unique_prn_rule: count distinct prn values; repeated rows for the same prn on multiple channels count once

eligible_event_support.comparison: exact equality across all detectors after identical exclusion
eligible_event_support.per_detector_hash: SHA-256 of canonical sorted eligible pooled-event identities

expected_frozen_pooled_event_count_compa.expected_count_derivation: pooled-event count produced by the frozen PG-SCC pool_events() result using exactly scenario, phase, second

raw_row_support.comparison: exact equality across all detectors before pooling
raw_row_support.optional_channel_rule: append channel to the raw-row identity key if and only if channel exists in support metadata; channel presence must be consistent across detectors
raw_row_support.per_detector_hash: SHA-256 of canonical sorted raw-row identities

support_policy_order: prove identical raw-row support across all detectors
group pooled events by exactly scenario, phase, second
mark eligible iff unique prn count is at least 4
exclude sub-four-prn events identically from all detectors and record their identities and prn lists/counts
prove eligible-event sets are exactly identical across detectors
prove reconstructed pooled-event count equals the frozen PG-SCC result

dense_physics_diagnostic.projection_ratio: squared weighted norm of projection onto centered synthetic-template span divided by squared weighted perturbation norm

final_root_cause_rules.K3_WORTH_INDEPENDENT_CONFIRMATION: K3 exceeds the 95th percentile of both random and shuffled K3, is at least non-inferior to fixed9 on paired common support, has stable external static FPR <=0.05, and physical coordinates are stable across selector seeds
final_root_cause_rules.REPAIRABLE_BUT_REQUIRES_NEW_CONFIRMATION: at least one attack-independent implementation/objective/control defect is numerically supported and a repair can be specified without choosing on attack performance
final_root_cause_rules.TERMINATE_PG_SCC: dense teacher is weaker than fixed9 on common support and selector is not statistically identifiable or meaningfully above random masks

guard.selector_inputs: cleanStatic train/selection plus preregistered synthetic bank only

immutability.masks: byte/structurally identical to frozen R1 inputs
immutability.thresholds: byte/numerically identical to frozen R1 inputs
immutability.verdict_criteria: unchanged from R1 except final labels already declared by the R2 immutable contract

nested_mask_accounting.coordinate_order: frozen pg_scc_k3 order, then exact set difference pg_scc_k5\pg_scc_k3 in frozen k5 order, then exact set difference pg_scc_k9\pg_scc_k5 in frozen k9 order

random_masks.selection_metric: synthetic validation sparse-GLRT and teacher-preservation only; attack metrics report-only

statistical_rules.mask_identifiable_if: median pairwise Jaccard >=0.5 and learned synthetic-GLRT metric exceeds random 95th percentile
